visual_requirements.description: Normal-size ancient Hawaiian warriors carrying spears in ancient battle clothing
Feet suspended above ground leaving no trace, bright torches announcing their approach
Sacred night coastal march rising from ocean toward sacred places

aura: Levitation c06 and torchlit approach c11 create sacred awe, no added aura or glowing eyes.

Simple one-piece hardwood spears with carved pointed wood, without attached metal/stone blades or socket collars, follow Claude traditional-character correction.

Clearly visible space beneath all feet and unbroken still-water reflections visualize suspension without trace c06. Desaturated painterly faces and direct grave stare convey ancestral ghosts c01/c07 without inventing skeletal anatomy or glowing eyes.
A vanguard of warriors, not the specific five-abreast god procession; no invented tattoos, aura or modern portrait likeness.
Self-rejected correction attempt02 for a leaf-shaped spear tip/collar; repeat with narrow cylindrical wood smoothly tapering to a needle point, never wider than shaft.
prompt: ONE original square premium PAINTERLY CINEMATIC Mitoloka illustration of Nightmarchers, the deadly sacred GHOSTS of ancient Hawaiian warriors. Use strongly visible oil-painted brushwork and sculpted shadows, never photographic faces. ANATOMY: THREE distinct ADULT Hawaiian warrior spirits foremost, more shadowy warriors marching in ranks behind. Each normal human size, ONE head, TWO natural dark eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs. Grave angular ancient faces, ashen desaturated skin in red torchlight, no modern portrait resemblance, no wounds, skeletal features, glowing eyes, masks or tattoos [nightmarchers-c01,c05]. COSTUME: fully opaque plain MALO LOINCLOTHS wrap hips and groin, shoulder capes hang over back and shoulders; cloth is SMOOTH BEATEN KAPA BARK CLOTH, flat dense cream/tan sheets with soft crumples and clean edges, NOT woven fabric, NOT burlap, NOT sacks, no fringes, no ankle skirts, no togas, no robe. No helmets, feathers, jewelry, armor or fantasy costume [c05,c18]. WEAPONS: long ROUND DARK WOODEN POLES with their own ends simply WHITTLED TO THIN NEEDLE POINTS like giant sharpened pencils. Each pole maintains its NARROW CYLINDRICAL THICKNESS until a smooth LONG TAPER at the very end, no widening whatsoever. One uninterrupted stick of matte dark brown wood. NEVER leaf shape, flat blade, flared or broadened tip, triangular spearhead, diamond point, socket, collar, separate head, binding, engraving, metal or stone. Think sharpened wooden fishing pole, not a medieval spear [c05]. MOMENT: ADVANCE inexorably toward viewer above a black still-water tidal pool, spear leader in foreground holding his wooden spear diagonally across torso with BOTH HANDS. His head faces straight at lens, severe unblinking DIRECT EYE CONTACT, mouth closed. Other warriors advance behind as a solemn sacred rank [c03,c04,c07]. POWER: all visible bare feet HOVER A FULL FOREARM LENGTH ABOVE THE FLAT WATER, not walking on water, not touching it. Leave an obvious wide EMPTY DARK GAP between every foot and its reflection. Feet at about ONE THIRD UP FROM BOTTOM of frame. Bottom third shows utterly STILL mirror water and UNDISTURBED reflections beneath them, NO ripples, wakes, splashes, footprints or touching shadows. Light physical cold grey mist low over water, thin enough not to hide the floating gap [c06]. SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low camera at water surface looking upward, leader fills height and fixes viewer with stare, feet and large empty hover gaps remain in frame. Human size, no giants. LIGHT & WEATHER: REAL RED-BURNING TORCHES among rear ranks are the ONLY LIGHT SOURCE, hard deep red-orange light across grave painted faces and smooth kapa with near-black shadows. No moon, moonlight, blue lighting, glowing bodies, fog aura or luminous outlines [c11,c18]. SURFACE: smooth beaten bark cloth, matte continuous dark wood, bare feet and stark weathered ancestral faces, black volcanic rocks, glass-flat black tidal water. SETTING: night Hawaiian lava-rock shoreline, dark ocean and further ranks behind, procession rising from ocean toward sacred sites [c04]. MOOD: overwhelming sacred ancestral authority, the DEAD approach and see the viewer, solemn dangerous awe, never a beach reenactment, ordinary friendly soldiers or calm living modern men. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or digits; no invented tattoos, skeletal features, glowing eyes, aura, runes, energy ribbons or borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no victims, nudity or gore. Strong painterly house style and hovering feet must be unmistakable at 200px.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Keep: normal-size warrior spirits marching in ranks from the night ocean onto a lava-rock shore toward the viewer (nightmarchers-c03/c04/c05). Keep real torches growing bright (c11), burning red per c18. Keep every foot clearly hovering above the ground with no footprints (c06). No victims, gore, eye beams, text or aura. Fix: (a) Costume from ancient usage (c18). Use malo loincloths and shoulder capes of smooth, beaten kapa bark cloth, not woven burlap. If chiefly costume is shown, give a feathered cloak and a crested helmet to one leading chief only. Nothing should read as a sackcloth toga, a fringed burlap robe, or Western or fantasy armour. (b) Spears: one-piece dark hardwood shafts with carved wooden points. No metal or stone blades, sockets or bindings. (c) Make them read as the dead at 200px. Paint them in the house painterly style as grave, ancient figures, not as a photographic portrait of present-day men. The leader fixes his stare directly on the viewer, since looking upon them is fatal (c07). Lift the feet so the gap is unmistakable even at 200px, for example above still water whose reflections show no disturbance, with cold mist around the legs. Keep torchlight as the one light source. No invented tattoos, glowing eyes or skeletal features.

Codex native self-reject: leader spear still has a leaf-shaped flared head with collar-like separation, so one-piece hardwood construction is insufficiently clear. Keep corrected painterly faces, kapa and levitation; regenerate plain tapering wooden poles.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px and 200px inspected: grave painterly ancient warrior spirits in smooth beaten bark-cloth malo and capes, no woven sackcloth togas. Spears are continuous narrow dark wood with simple tapered points, no widened separate blades or socket. Leader looks directly at viewer; normal human anatomy and hand grip. Wide gaps separate all foreground feet from undisturbed pool and reflections (c06), leg mist does not conceal levitation at 200px. Deadly sacred rank c01/c07, real red torches sole lighting c11, no body aura, invented tattoos, skeletons or eye beams. Self-rejected first correction for blade-like spear, retained archive. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and crops of the leader's face, both his hands and his hips; the flanking warriors and their hips; the feet of all three foreground warriors above the water; all spear tips and the leader's spear butt; and the background. This redraw answers the r04 reject. (a) Costume from ancient usage (nightmarchers-c05/c18). Each foreground warrior wears an opaque wrapped malo loincloth with a front flap and a shoulder cape knotted at the chest, both of tan, paper-like beaten bark cloth. No woven burlap, sackcloth toga, fringed robe, armour, helmet or fantasy costume. (b) The spears are long, plain, one-piece dark wooden poles that taper smoothly to needle points (c05). They have no metal or stone heads, sockets, collars or bindings, and the leader's spear ends in a plain cut butt. (c) They read as the dead at 200px. Their grave, weathered faces are painted with visible brushwork, and the leader stares straight at the viewer (looking upon them is fatal, c07). All six bare feet of the three foremost warriors hover well above a mirror-still black tidal pool, with a clear gap and low grey mist beneath them and no ripples or footprints (c06). The three foreground warriors each have one head, two eyes and two legs, and their visible hands have normal digit counts. Ranks of spear-bearers march behind them from the dark lava-rock shore (c03/c04). Many torches burn red among the ranks as the only light, lighting the smoke red (c11/c18). No victims, gore, eye beams, invented tattoos, skeletal features, text or borrowed design, and the ancestral warriors are depicted with grave dignity. At 200px the hovering, torch-lit, armed rank advancing on the low camera is menacing and awe-inspiring. Limitations: the bark cloth is crinkled and ragged-edged rather than fully smooth, and a red-lit smoke wash fills the upper sky.
